analysis_vm.name: threats2-analysis
analysis_vm.execution: Unicorn x86 emulation with synthetic Windows loader/export, heap, virtual file and sequential worker models; no guest OS APIs executed

limitations: Only the truncated ELF remains in purgatory. Follow-up recovered enough hostile intent evidence for the executable and PDF; full concealed executable functionality and the offline PDF landing page remain unresolved.

JVM arithmetic string reconstruction is currently recorded as bytecode observations; the filefacts literal view does not surface these computed strings. Token-theft details were recovered manually and are not claimed by the new bytecode traits.
The PowerShell AES/XOR layers were decoded offline for review; the original outer-layer scan does not expose these custom-decoded payloads as archive children.
changes: Cover ScriptBlock method invocation as an AES loader execution sink.
Constrain OOB host-recon and daemon co-occurrence to local file/line evidence.
Require sensitive agent actions, rather than generic setup verbs near API-key mentions.
Match attribute-breakout payloads at the beginning of parsed literal values, preserving ordinary generated HTML.
Reuse the canonical Go WebSocket capability and prevent unrelated embedded library identities from hiding it.
Extend precise Overlord package/frame fingerprints to compiled binaries.
Add browser-cloning/injection, proxy autostart/stage-launcher and arithmetic-bytecode observations.
Relocate the generic Python write_file helper from copy to write and update exact consumers; this is a matcher-preserving taxonomy correction.
Expose PDF Forms shared-template navigation as a neutral endpoint capability; hostile PDF verdict additionally uses recovered downstream content.

samples.name: pty3
samples.label: purgatory

samples.name: secured_stub1.ps1
samples.label: bad
samples.reason: AES-256-CBC layer decrypts to an XOR/Base64 reflective assembly loader targeting aspnet_compiler.exe. The decoded managed injector performs native process creation/context/memory operations; a separate embedded importless packed PE is passed as its payload. The outer ScriptBlock sink is now detected. One hostile outer finding and three hostile findings on the extracted packed payload; extra duplicate convictions were not invented.
